response.text:
**Metric:** Year-over-year growth in Amazon's total revenue (net sales) for fiscal year 2023 vs. fiscal year 2022.

**Evidence (10-K, XBRL `RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax`):**
- FY2023: $574,785,000,000 — accession 0001018724-24-000008, filed 2024-02-02 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872424000008/0001018724-24-000008-index.htm)
- FY2022: $513,983,000,000 — accession 0001018724-23-000004, filed 2023-02-03 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872423000004/0001018724-23-000004-index.htm)

**Calculation:** ($574,785M − $513,983M) / $513,983M = $60,802M / $513,983M ≈ 0.11830, i.e. about 11.83% growth.

ANSWER: 11.83% YoY revenue growth (FY2023 vs FY2022)
